entries.reason: ALPINE-CVE-2026-4738 (zlib 1.3.2-r1) is in the pinned golang:1.27-alpine base image; no upstream digest ships the fixed zlib 1.4-r0 yet. The Dockerfile installs zlib>=1.4-r0 during the build and fails if that version is unavailable, but Nox inventories the base image, not the built one. Remove this entry when the FROM digest moves to an image with zlib >= 1.4-r0.

ALPINE-CVE-2026-4738 (zlib 1.3.2-r1) is in the pinned node:22-alpine base image; no upstream digest ships the fixed zlib 1.4-r0 yet. The Dockerfile installs zlib>=1.4-r0 during the build and fails if that version is unavailable, but Nox inventories the base image, not the built one. Remove this entry when the FROM digest moves to an image with zlib >= 1.4-r0.

Temporary maintainer-approved release exception through 2026-11-20; review by this date, and remove the baseline as soon as a supported Node runtime ships OpenSSL 3.5.10+. Tracked in https://github.com/felixgeelhaar/ghostline/issues/45. Nox confirmed four OpenSSL 3.5.9 advisories in the pinned Node image; vulnerable code reachability is undetermined. This baseline records accepted interim risk and is not evidence the findings are fixed.
